SELECT AS "period", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = 1
AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND c.REGISTRATION_STATUS <> 0
GROUP BY ORDER BY "period"

SELECT AS "period",
SUM(NVL(a.TOTAL_INCOMES, 0) ) SUM(NVL(a.TOTAL_COSTS, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0)) AS "amount",
SUM(NVL(a.RCPTS_NUM, 0)) - SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_NUM, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.RCPTS_NUM, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_NUM, 0)) AS "receipt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ORDER BY "period"

SELECT nvl(q.SOURCE_NAME,decode(c.operator_no,'9101','自助机','窗口')) AS "name", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c LEFT JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_MOP_QUEUE q ON q.STAT_DATE = c.STAT_DATE AND q.visit_no = c.visit_no
WHERE c.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND c.REGISTRATION_STATUS <> 0
WHERE c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = 1
GROUP BY nvl(q.SOURCE_NAME,decode(c.operator_no,'9101','自助机','窗口')) ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT DECODE(c.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') AS "name", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c
WHERE c.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND c.REGISTRATION_STATUS <> 0
WHERE c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = 1
GROUP BY DECODE(c.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT DECODE(r.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') AS "name", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER r
WHERE r.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND r.REGISTRATION_STATUS <> 0
WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND r.IS_RETURN_TYPE = 1
GROUP BY DECODE(r.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT p.MONEY_TYPE AS "name",
NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0) - NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_PAYMENTS_MONEY p JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r ON r.RCPT_NO = p.RCPT_NO WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0
AND r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0
GROUP BY p.MONEY_TYPE ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SELECT DECODE(a.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') AS "name",
SUM(NVL(a.RCPTS_NUM, 0)) - SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_NUM, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.RCPTS_NUM, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_NUM, 0)) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DECODE(a.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT m.MONEY_TYPE AS "name",
NVL(SUM(NVL(m.INCOME_AMOUNT,0) - NVL(m.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(m.INCOME_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(m.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MONEY m JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a ON a.ACCT_NO = m.ACCT_NO WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY m.MONEY_TYPE ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN m.MONEY_TYPE IN ('医改统筹','医院垫支') THEN '医改统筹/医院垫支' WHEN m.MONEY_TYPE IN ('支付宝','现金','信用卡','银行卡','微信','自助POS','支票') THEN '实收金额' ELSE '应收账款' END AS "name",
NVL(SUM(NVL(m.INCOME_AMOUNT,0) - NVL(m.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(m.INCOME_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(m.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MONEY m JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a ON a.ACCT_NO = m.ACCT_NO WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY CASE WHEN m.MONEY_TYPE IN ('医改统筹','医院垫支') THEN '医改统筹/医院垫支' WHEN m.MONEY_TYPE IN ('支付宝','现金','信用卡','银行卡','微信','自助POS','支票') THEN '实收金额' ELSE '应收账款' END ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SELECT p.MONEY_TYPE AS "name",
NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)-NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_PAYMENTS_MONEY p JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT rc ON rc.RCPT_NO = p.RCPT_NO WHERE rc.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND p.MONEY_TYPE NOT IN ('医改统筹','医院垫支','支付宝','现金','信用卡','银行卡','微信','自助POS','支票') GROUP BY p.MONEY_TYPE ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SELECT p.MONEY_TYPE AS "name",

NVL(SUM(NVL(a.TOTAL_INCOMES, 0) ), 0) NVL(SUM(NVL(a.TOTAL_COSTS, 0)), 0) NVL(SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DECODE(a.OPERATOR_NO, '9101','自助机', 'C746','线上退费', '窗口') ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SUM(NVL(m.INCOME_AMOUNT,0)-NVL(m.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)) SUM(NVL(m.INCOME_AMOUNT,0)) NVL(SUM(NVL(m.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MONEY m JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a ON a.ACCT_NO = m.ACCT_NO WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY m.MONEY_TYPE ORDER BY "amount" DESC
